name: Hetch Hetchy Reservoir
place: Tuolumne County, in Yosemite National Park

summary.value: The start of the regional water system: Tuolumne River water impounded by O'Shaughnessy Dam, which passes through hydroelectric powerhouses on its way to the Bay Area.

headline: O'Shaughnessy Dam holds the Tuolumne River in Yosemite's Hetch Hetchy Valley, where the Bay Area's water begins.

facts.label: Water system
facts.value: Hetch Hetchy Regional Water System, serving 2.7 million customers
